qa_pairs.question: Please compare the change trend of the annual per capita coffee consumption (cups) in 'Per capita annual coffee consumption in China (cups)' from 2020 → 2022 → 2023 → 2025 with the change trend of the scores in 'Consumers' Preferences for the Integration of Coffee Shops with Different Business Forms' from Bookstore Coffee → Garden Coffee → Camping Coffee. qa_pairs.explanation: The annual per capita coffee consumption increased continuously from 9.1 → 11.3 → 16.74 → 20; while the scores of the three cross - border business forms decreased continuously from 62 → 58 → 50. One increased and the other decreased, so the trends are opposite.

qa_pairs.question: Please compare the score sequence of the top three items (Bookstore Coffee → Garden Coffee → Camping Coffee) in 'Consumers' Preferences for the Integration of Coffee Shops with Different Business Forms' with the proportion sequence of the top three options (Have visited → Often visit → Haven't visited but quite interested) in 'Consumers' willingness to experience Shanghai - style cafes'. qa_pairs.question: Multiply the per capita annual coffee consumption in 2023 by the percentage of consumers who drink coffee once a day or more. What is the resulting annual coffee consumption? Round to 2 decimal places.
qa_pairs.explanation: Per capita annual coffee consumption in 2023 × Percentage of consumers who drink coffee once a day or more = 16.74 × 32% = 5.3568 ≈ 5.36
